title: Dashboard blank on session resume after release 24.3
symptom: The dashboard stays blank for 3 to 10 seconds after a session resumes. It fills in on its own and nothing is written to the error log.
diagnosis: Under investigation. Tickets start in the week 24.3 reached general release, and no account still on 24.2 or earlier has reported it.
interimAction: Do not roll the account back. Record the account reference, the region and whether the tab had been idle for more than eight hours, and attach the session resume trace.
openQuestions: Is the fault in chart-kit's mount path or in the session refresh broadcast from the auth SDK?
Does pinning 24.2 clear it? No account has been pinned back yet.
Community forum posts predate the first ticket by roughly two weeks — are those the same failure?
